qualification.details: Research Scientist-II (PDF): PhD degree in the relevant branch of Science/ Technology or equivalent (M.Sc. with CGPA not below 6.0 on a 10-point scale or 55% marks) OR First-class Post Graduate Degree in a relevant subject (Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Microbiology, Biochemistry, Bioinformatics etc.) with 3 years of post-qualification R&D/working experience. Relevant hands-on laboratory experience and strong background in the area of Bioinformatics/Parasite culture.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for CURAJ Research Scientist-II (PDF) Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 12-10-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

content_sections.text: Research Scientist-II (PDF): PhD degree in the relevant branch of Science/ Technology or equivalent (M.Sc. with CGPA not below 6.0 on a 10-point scale or 55% marks) OR First-class Post Graduate Degree in a relevant subject (Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Microbiology, Biochemistry, Bioinformatics etc.) with 3 years of post-qualification R&D/working experience. Relevant hands-on laboratory experience and strong background in the area of Bioinformatics/Parasite culture.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Central University of Rajasthan (CURAJ) for an ICMR-funded research project based in Ajmer, Rajasthan.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by CURAJ?
faq.answer: CURAJ has advertised for the post of Research Scientist-II (PDF) under project-based employment conditions in the field of research.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Research Scientist-II (PDF) position at the Central University of Rajasthan.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Research Scientist-II?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a PhD degree in a relevant branch of Science/Technology or a first-class Post Graduate Degree with 3 years of post-qualification R&D experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Research Scientist-II (PDF) post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 67,000 plus HRA per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to apply for this job?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed application via email to the Central University of Rajasthan is 12-10-2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for CURAJ Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to apply exclusively via email by sending their applications and scanned documents to the designated university email address.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification released by the Central University of Rajasthan for this position.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Research Scientist-II role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves initial shortlisting of candidates based on their merit and qualifications, followed by a personal interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I check the official website of the university?
faq.answer: You can visit the official website of the Central University of Rajasthan at http://www.curaj.ac.in for further details and updates.
